_readme: Edit this file to set your alerts, then commit and push. Each entry needs a 'symbol' and exactly one of 'above' or 'below' — even parked entries, so give them a placeholder level. Set 'enabled': true to arm one. Parked entries still get their price printed in the run log, so you can read current prices there before choosing a level.
